title: Inside the FBI’s little-known annual crypto crime gathering
summary: The Virtual Asset Technical Exchange brings together investigators, law enforcement officials, and crypto-security specialists to exchange intelligence on a wide range of crimes involving digital assets.

title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the chain settling $150 billion of stablecoins a week
summary: Tron launched as a content-distribution project and has become the settlement layer for a large share of the world's USDT, processing roughly $150 billion to $190 billion of stablecoin transfers a week. Josh Olszewicz of Canary Capital breaks down how the network's economics work and what stablecoin regulation could do to the thesis.

title: Bitcoin's $16 billion quarterly options settlement arrives with a 'call-heavy' book
summary: Nearly $18 billion in bitcoin and ether options will expire on Friday, potentially reshaping dealer hedging flows and short-term volatility.

title: MoonPay to acquire SEC-registered North Capital in $60 million all-stock deal
summary: The acquisition will support MoonPay’s aim of supporting mass adoption of tokenized real-world assets, CEO Ivan Soto-Wright said.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips as higher rates and dollar pressure markets
summary: Bitcoin matched Monday's high near $87,300 before running into selling, while bitcoin cash surged 28% on a CME futures listing and ZEC added 9%.
